caption:
Lulu carries gear on one side across the site all day, but her first side plank collapsed in three seconds.

Side planks load the muscles along the side of your trunk and hip together. That can help with carrying on one side, changing direction and balancing on one leg.

Start on your knees with your elbow under your shoulder. Hold 10 to 20 seconds, 3 times each side, breathing normally. When that feels easy, straighten your legs. Add time before difficulty, and keep holds clean rather than long.

A grumbly shoulder may just need a different version. Sharp back pain or pain into a leg is worth getting checked. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio.
